user.title: Denon RS-232
user.description: Address of the serial-to-IP bridge wired to the Denon RS-232 port. Unfolded Circle Dock 3: external port 2 = TCP 5000 (enable "RS232 TCP server" in the dock's web interface).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the bridge at this address and port.
error.no_response: The bridge is reachable but the Denon does not answer PW? (check the cable, the dock port mode RS232 9600 8N1, or swap Tip/Ring).
